That's under the $50 gate, so it passes (no gateway within 40 km needed). Google 4.7 over 829. Hookups, max length, Wi-Fi and the booking link are now read from KOA's own page.
flags: PRICE: passes the $50 gate. In season (April, July, September 2027) the cheapest type is 'Back In, 30 Amps, Water/Electric' at $47-50 (up to 50 ft deep, so a 23-ft rig fits). Off season (Nov 2026, Mar 2027) only 4 of 9 types are open, and the cheapest is $45-60 for a full-hookup pull-through. The earlier $50 low (May 2027 weeknight) was the in-season water/electric rate. No gateway within 40 km.
Presence: KOA's own site plus phone 785-890-5701 (matches the stored phone). Google 'Goodland KOA Journey' 4.7 over 829 reviews (RV Life 4.5 over 448).

Long-stay tests: transient I-70 stop. Nightly booking is open to the public, it sells single nights, there are camper reviews from overnighters dated Oct 2026, and nothing says it is mostly seasonal or residential. 'Extended Stays' are offered as a side line, and no age or rig-age rule was seen. Passes.

Season lead: KOA's booking form sells nights on 2026-11-17 and 2027-03-16 (4 of 9 types), so it looks year-round with reduced winter capacity, but the page doesn't state a season, so season was left unset. Pool 4/1-10/31.
Not waterfront: confirmed (no water nearby). The pin 39.33845,-101.69798 is ~65 m from Google's 39.33788,-101.69757, which is fine.
